text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before Vodka departed for overseas, Daiwa 
Scarlet poured her heart out to her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the press conference, as if all her 
doubts had vanished, she passionately 
expressed her determination for the Arima 
Kinen.
